entries.text_de: um 1114, Quelle von Hn, u. S. 547, und Vorlage für die Hss. Lond (d. i. K Co Or) Dm T R (dem Lh folgt) und m, d. i. jüngste Ausgabe, welche M Hk Br vertreten; u. S. 529. Vgl. aq, hq, hlq, lq, sq. Stücke daraus bringen Ip Ml und Sc, o. S. xxxi. xxxix. Moderne Copien: Harley 362. 596, Ed, Jl und Corpus 168. 348.
entries.text_en: c. 1114, source of Hn, below, p. 547, and exemplar for the MSS Lond (i.e. K Co Or) Dm T R (which Lh follows) and m, i.e. the latest edition, which M Hk Br represent; below, p. 529. Cf. aq, hq, hlq, lq, sq. Extracts from it are given by Ip Ml and Sc, above, pp. xxxi. xxxix. Modern copies: Harley 362. 596, Ed, Jl and Corpus 168. 348.

transcription.doubts: Only 'Quadr' of the heading is bold; '[ipartitus]' is roman. 'u. S. 547' — the 4 is slightly damaged in the print but reads 547. A small dot under the D of 'Dm' is taken as a print speck.

display_fields.shelfmark: Quadripartitus: not a manuscript, but the Latin translation of the laws (c. 1110), which survives in several MSS

notes.text: Liebermann’s Q is the Quadripartitus, the early twelfth-century Latin translation of the Old English laws. It is listed with the law codes, where its own MSS are given. In Excom XII alone, Liebermann’s Q is a manuscript, Cotton Vespasian D.xv (the next entry).
